const cfg = { proxy: "127.0.0.1", port: 7897 };
const js = [
 "const http=require('http');",
 "const cfg=" + JSON.stringify(cfg) + ";",
 "const UA='Mozilla/5.0 Chrome/155';",
 "function get(u,acc){return new Promise(function(resolve,reject){",
 " const pu=new URL(u);",
 " http.get({host:cfg.proxy,port:cfg.port,path:u,headers:{Host:pu.host,'User-Agent':UA,'Accept':acc||'application/json'}},function(res){",
 " const c=[];res.on('data',function(d){c.push(d)});",
 " res.on('end',function(){resolve({status:res.statusCode, body:Buffer.concat(c).toString('utf8')})});",
 " }).on('error',reject);",
 "});}",
 "(async function(){",
 " // 1) 那个开源 n8n workflow 仓库",
 " const r=await get('https://api.github.com/repos/sirlifehacker/n8n-automations','application/vnd.github+json');",
 " if(r.status===200){",
 " const j=JSON.parse(r.body);",
 " console.log('=== sirlifehacker/n8n-automations ===');",
 " console.log(' stars:', j.stargazers_count, '| forks:', j.forks_count, '| created:', j.created_at);",
 " console.log(' desc:', j.description);",
 " console.log(' topics:', JSON.stringify(j.topics));",
 " } else { console.log('repo status', r.status); }",
 " await new Promise(function(x){setTimeout(x,3000)});",
 " // 2) 仓库文件列表",
 " const r2=await get('https://api.github.com/repos/sirlifehacker/n8n-automations/contents/','application/vnd.github+json');",
 " if(r2.status===200){",
 " const j2=JSON.parse(r2.body);",
 " console.log('\\n 文件列表:');",
 " for(const f of j2) console.log(' '+(f.type==='dir'?'[D] ':' ')+f.name+' ('+f.size+'b)');",
 " } else { console.log('contents status', r2.status, r2.body.substring(0,150)); }",
 "})();",
].join("\n");
await tools.write({ file_path: "C:/Users/jjq21/AppData/Local/Temp/ofm-n8n.cjs", content: js });
const f = "C:/Users/jjq21/AppData/Local/Temp/ofm-n8n.cjs";
const r = await tools.pwsh({ command: "node " + JSON.stringify(f), description: "Fetch n8n automation repo details", timeoutMs: 200000 });
console.log(r.kind === "foreground" ? (r.stdout.text + r.stderr.text).slice(0, 5000) : JSON.stringify(r).slice(0, 2000));

const cfg = { proxy: "127.0.0.1", port: 7897 };
const js = [
  "const http=require('http');",
  "const cfg=" + JSON.stringify(cfg) + ";",
  "const UA='Mozilla/5.0 Chrome/155';",
  "function get(u,acc){return new Promise(function(resolve,reject){",
  "  const pu=new URL(u);",
  "  http.get({host:cfg.proxy,port:cfg.port,path:u,headers:{Host:pu.host,'User-Agent':UA,'Accept':acc||'application/json'}},function(res){",
  "    const c=[];res.on('data',function(d){c.push(d)});",
  "    res.on('end',function(){resolve({status:res.statusCode, body:Buffer.concat(c).toString('utf8')})});",
  "  }).on('error',reject);",
  "});}",
  "(async function(){",
  "  // 1) 那个开源 n8n workflow 仓库",
  "  const r=await get('https://api.github.com/repos/sirlifehacker/n8n-automations','application/vnd.github+json');",
  "  if(r.status===200){",
  "    const j=JSON.parse(r.body);",
  "    console.log('=== sirlifehacker/n8n-automations ===');",
  "    console.log('  stars:', j.stargazers_count, '| forks:', j.forks_count, '| created:', j.created_at);",
  "    console.log('  desc:', j.description);",
  "    console.log('  topics:', JSON.stringify(j.topics));",
  "  } else { console.log('repo status', r.status); }",
  "  await new Promise(function(x){setTimeout(x,3000)});",
  "  // 2) 仓库文件列表",
  "  const r2=await get('https://api.github.com/repos/sirlifehacker/n8n-automations/contents/','application/vnd.github+json');",
  "  if(r2.status===200){",
  "    const j2=JSON.parse(r2.body);",
  "    console.log('\\n  文件列表:');",
  "    for(const f of j2) console.log('    '+(f.type==='dir'?'[D] ':'    ')+f.name+' ('+f.size+'b)');",
  "  } else { console.log('contents status', r2.status, r2.body.substring(0,150)); }",
  "})();",
].join("\n");
await tools.write({ file_path: "C:/Users/jjq21/AppData/Local/Temp/ofm-n8n.cjs", content: js });
const f = "C:/Users/jjq21/AppData/Local/Temp/ofm-n8n.cjs";
const r = await tools.pwsh({ command: "node " + JSON.stringify(f), description: "Fetch n8n automation repo details", timeoutMs: 200000 });
console.log(r.kind === "foreground" ? (r.stdout.text + r.stderr.text).slice(0, 5000) : JSON.stringify(r).slice(0, 2000));
